tff0zhg7.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Snow White Fir Hook-On Branches Tree
tff0zhg7.sourceDescription: The flocked Snow White Fir recreates a winter's morning after snowfall - from the comfort of your living room! As one of our heaviest flocked Christmas trees, recipients should prepare to be astounded by the gorgeous full foliage, dense snowy branches, and realistic silhouette. Our customers love how the branches appear to be weighed down by snow, while providing minimal mess all to provide the perfect backdrop for many Christmases to come! The Snow White Fir tree comes presented in an extra-wide box unlike other Christmas trees in order to keep the expertly flocked branches in position, making assembly quick and easy. Worried about assembling? The color-coded branches simply need inserting into the centre pole, which is also flocked and the top section can be adjusted to create the desired effect of a winter wonderland Christmas tree. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. t1898c8q.variantName: Ark Mat 58cm Artificial Wreath - Russet Ember
t1898c8q.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom

kbhqf3xa.sourceDescription: Showcase your festive decorations from every angle with the Neo Rotating Christmas Tree Stand, suitable for trees up to 2.1m tall. Featuring a 50cm diameter star-shaped base, this electric Christmas tree stand offers a choice of lighting only or lighting with rotation, controlled by a simple three-position switch. Centre pole holders are available in 19mm, 22mm and 32mm sizes to accommodate different tree poles, while the integrated power outlet lets you connect your Christmas tree lights for an eye-catching festive display. SUITABLE FOR TREES UP TO 2.1M: Display your Christmas tree on a 50cm diameter, five-point star-shaped base. ROTATING CHRISTMAS TREE STAND: Show off your baubles, lights and decorations from every angle with powered rotation. THREE-POSITION SWITCH: Switch up for lights on with rotation off, select the middle position to turn both off, or switch down for lights and rotation on. CHOICE OF POLE HOLDERS: Centre pole holders are available in 19mm, 22mm and 32mm diameters. Select the correct size for your tree. INTEGRATED LIGHTING OUTLET: Connect your Christmas tree lights using the built-in outlet. Supplied with a black power cable and UK three-pin plug. For indoor domestic use only. This product is not a toy. Keep children and pets away from the rotating mechanism, electrical connections and power cable. Suitable for artificial christmas trees up to 2.1m tall, provided the tree is compatible with the stand. Ensure the stand is positioned on a flat, stable and level surface before use. Select the correct pole holder size (19mm, 22mm or 32mm) and ensure the tree is securely fitted before switching on. Do not exceed the manufacturer's specified weight or electrical load limits. Keep hands, clothing, decorations and other objects clear of moving parts during rotation. Only connect compatible christmas tree lights to the integrated power outlet. Do not overload the socket or use damaged electrical cables. Keep away from water, moisture and heat sources. Do not operate if the stand, plug, cable or rotating mechanism is damaged. Always switch off and unplug before assembling, adjusting, cleaning or moving the tree. Do not leave the product operating unattended. Sto Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW
